headline: 40% growth in 5 years: financial holding companies shift to a 'non-interest business model' [Non-interest survival race]
summary: Non-interest income of the five largest Korean financial groups rose more than 40 percent over five years. In the first half of this year alone it exceeded 10 trillion won.
why: Financial holding groups in South Korea are diversifying from lending into fee-based businesses such as securities, insurance and card operations, which shapes their profitability and ranking.
